g.text: Fankata found temperatures from k10temp, nvme and acpitz,
but no fan control. The board’s sensor driver may not be loaded.
Finds out why fans are missing, and fixes what it can.
Found a Nuvoton NCT6798D Super I/O chip
The firmware won’t share the chip
nothing more could be fixed automatically
# Added by Fankata (Troubleshoot fans). Delete this file and run
